models.name: SLIM
models.comment: Elastic-net item-item regression, one coordinate-descent problem per item; v2: FMA coordinate-descent axpy; fused recommend kernel reading the fitted matrices in place

models.name: EASE
models.comment: Closed-form dense item-item model; v2: fused dense-row recommend kernel (was a scipy sparse-by-dense product and a dense score matrix)

models.name: RP3Beta
models.comment: Three-step random walk with popularity penalty; v2: cached thread pools, serial small batches, fused recommend kernel reading the fitted matrices in place

models.name: BPR
models.comment: Pairwise matrix factorization; seeded, so it fits on one thread; v2: fused latent-factor recommend kernel (was a numpy score matrix plus bias broadcasts)

models.name: BM25
models.comment: Item-item neighbours with BM25 weighting; v2: cached thread pools, serial small batches, fused recommend kernel reading the fitted matrices in place

models.name: ItemKNN
models.comment: Cosine item-item neighbours; v2: cached thread pools, serial small batches, dense accumulation for long rows

models.name: MostPopular
models.comment: Popularity baseline; its score does not depend on the query; v2: ranked by the latent-factor kernel as a zero-factor model

models.name: ALS
models.comment: libFM-style ALS with global, user and item biases; v2: fused latent-factor recommend kernel (was a numpy score matrix plus bias broadcasts)

models.name: SimpleX
models.comment: Cosine contrastive CF; a user fuses its own embedding with an aggregate of its items; needs the nn extra

models.name: XSimGCL
models.comment: LightGCN plus a contrast between two noise-perturbed layers of its own propagation; needs the nn extra
